meta.title: Fish export markets: the Middle East and beyond
meta.description: Fresh Egyptian fish for importers in 7+ markets: UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain, Lebanon, Qatar, Iraq and Syria, by air and road. Europe is next in our plan.

approach.title: Each market has its own specification
approach.intro: We agree the details with each importer before the first shipment.

points.title: Species and weight grade
points.text: Species, weight grade and product form are agreed for each importer and each market.

points.title: Packing and labels
points.text: Packing and box labels are set to what your market and your customers require.

points.title: Documents
points.text: The export documents for each shipment are agreed for your destination.

process.title: From your first message to the shipment

steps.title: Send your requirements
steps.text: Species, weight grade, quantity, packing and destination.

steps.title: Review with our export team
steps.text: We check supply, the specification and the import requirements of your destination.

steps.title: Agree the order
steps.text: Species, grade, packing, transport, schedule and price are confirmed in writing for each order.

steps.title: Pack and ship
steps.text: We pack on ice and ship by air or road, with the export documents agreed for your destination.

transport.title: By air and by road
transport.intro: Fresh fish travels chilled and packed on ice. It leaves the plant in our own refrigerated trucks, then goes by air or road freight.

modes.title: Air freight
modes.text: Packed on ice in insulated boxes for air cargo, for destinations served by air.

modes.title: Road freight
modes.text: Refrigerated road transport where the destination can be reached by land.

transport.note: We do not publish fixed transit times: they depend on the route and the booking, and are confirmed for each shipment.

support.title: Clear terms for every order

items.title: Prices confirmed per order
items.text: Prices depend on the species, weight grade, quantity, packing and delivery terms, so we confirm them for each order.

items.title: Clear responsibilities
items.text: Who handles export documents, import clearance and delivery is agreed in writing for each order.

items.title: Two direct channels
items.text: WhatsApp goes directly to our management, for fast deals. Email goes to the export team, for details and documents.

support.guide_link: Read the guide to importing fresh fish from Egypt

new_market.title: Your country is planned or not listed?
new_market.text: Tell us your destination. Our export team reviews each new market case by case.

disclaimer: Every shipment depends on the import rules of the destination, current supply and the order terms agreed in writing.
